definitions.gloss: on the platform; on stage; at the podium
definitions.explanation: The raised platform or stage area where someone stands to give a speech, receive an award, or perform at a ceremony or event.

examples.japanese: {壇上|だんじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|あ}がって→上がる：00615_agaru⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}した→挨拶する：01797_aisatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: I went up on stage and gave a greeting.

examples.japanese: {壇上|だんじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{演者|えんじゃ}→演者：13436_enja⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{拍手|はくしゅ}→拍手：03553_hakushu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{送|おく}られた→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: Applause was given to the performer on stage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卒業式|そつぎょうしき}→卒業式：05584_sotsugyoushiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{壇上|だんじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}ち→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧、⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧{答辞|とうじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}み{上|あ}げた→読み上げる：04604_yomiageru⟧。
examples.english: I stood on the stage at the graduation ceremony and read the farewell address as the class representative.

notes:
Refers to the raised platform or stage area where someone stands to give a speech, receive an award, or perform. Combines ⟦{壇|だん}→壇：23016_dan⟧ (platform, podium) and ⟦{上|じょう}→〜上：30365_jou⟧ (on top of).

USAGE:
- Commonly used with positional expressions: {壇上|だんじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧ (to go up on stage), {壇上|だんじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (to stand on stage)
- Used in contexts like ceremonies, speeches, presentations, and award events
- Can also be used as a location modifier: {壇上|だんじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (the person on stage)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {壇上|だんじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧: to go up on stage
- {壇上|だんじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to stand on the platform
- {壇上|だんじょう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{降|お}りる→降りる：00568_oriru⟧: to come down from the stage
- {壇上|だんじょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}する→挨拶する：01797_aisatsusuru⟧: to give a greeting on stage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ステージ→ステージ：11047_suteeji⟧: stage — the loanword, broader in use (concerts, events)
- ⟦{舞台|ぶたい}→舞台：03606_butai⟧: stage — used for theater and performances, also figuratively
- ⟦{演壇|えんだん}→演壇：22662_endan⟧: speaker's platform, podium — specifically for giving speeches
- ⟦{登壇|とうだん}→登壇：13691_toudan⟧: going up to the podium — the act of ascending the stage
